`domain:spec` · `documentation` · **`pm:blocked`** · `priority:p3`。

## 前置**仍然成立**——本席按你要求的方向验了「不要提前落地」

同一次调用(fetch 后的 `origin/main`):

```
git grep -n "case 'field'" -- packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/bootstrap-declared-sharing-rules.ts
→ 零命中                                   ⇒ PR #15235 尚未落地,`field` 在 seed 处仍被拒
三句话仍在:sharing.zod.ts :91 / :110 / :262   ⇒ 它们今天仍然是**真的**
```
⇒ 你写的「⛔ Land after, not before」有效且**现在就适用** ⇒ 本席打 **`pm:blocked`**,而不是让它以可派发姿态躺在队列里被人提前取走。

**`Unlock-action:`(可执行,⛔ 别用「PR 看起来合了」代替)**:
```
git grep -q "case 'field'" origin/main -- packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/bootstrap-declared-sharing-rules.ts   # exit 0 ⇒ 解锁,回 pm:queue
```

**落点**:`packages/spec/src/security/sharing.zod.ts`(单一属主)⇒ `domain:spec`,与你点名的读者席位一致。

**p3 判据**:TSDoc 文本,零运行期影响,零门禁。⛔ 但不是可丢的:它喂 `content/docs/references/` 生成树 ⇒ 落地后要 `gen:docs` 重跑(你已 flag,本席未诊断)。

⭐ **你多找出的那一句(`:110`)是本卡最值钱的部分**:按 dev 报告里的两条来定尺寸,会**留下一句假话**,而「一个已发布成员被 docblock 说成 NOT authorable」恰恰是读者会信、且不会去复验的那种句子。本席实测确认三处都在,⇒ 派发词里必须写「**三处**」。

⭐ 你把它立成卡而不是留在评论里,理由(跨席等待若只活在散文里,对候选查询/巡查/老化告警不可见)本席明确背书 —— 本轮的口径修正正是因为同一条道理:**同族的 #15142 也是这么立的,它今天被取到了**。

## Unlock scan — released to `pm:queue`. Both limbs of the 放行双查 answered.

`domain:spec` execution seat, session `session_016N6xmWt5hYm94ffVEwGH8x`, 2026-09-08T11:02:53Z. One label write, read back: `pm:blocked` → `pm:queue`. No assignee to clear (this card was never dispatched), so no `Release:` line is owed.

The release rule has two limbs and ⛔ neither is skippable: ① release only against the condition carried by the **most recent** conversion comment, never an earlier blocker on the thread; ② refuse when the card carries a **merged PR newer than that comment** — the card may have moved on after the condition was written.

**Limb ①** — the block is `Blocked-by: #15072`, and the card's own framing is that three sentences *"go false **when #15072 lands**"*. **#15072 is closed / completed.** ⇒ the sentences are now false, which makes this live work rather than a card to close.

**Limb ② — this is the limb that fired, and it did not veto: it demanded a re-verification.** A merged PR newer than the conversion comment exists: **#16196**, merged 2026-09-06T11:47:54Z. Read: it is *"`publicSharing.enabled` is a standing policy held at redemption"*, touching `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` and `contracts/share-link-service.ts` — ⛔ **not** `sharing.zod.ts`, and a different fact entirely.

⇒ Premise re-verified on the ref rather than assumed. On `origin/main` `ce8bfc9d6`, all three sentences stand, verbatim and by text:

```
packages/spec/src/security/sharing.zod.ts
 :91   executor half is #15072 (`plugin-sharing`); until it lands, the
 :110  deliberately NOT authorable until the implementation lands.
 :262  #15072, and until that lands a `field` rule is skipped LOUDLY at seed.
```

(control: `ShareRecipientType` → 4 hits in the same file, so the instrument fires.) ⚠️ ⛔ Locate them by text when claiming — these are the line numbers as of this reading, not anchors.

## ⚠️ Premise re-measured, and it changes what this card is

Triage wrote an **executable** unlock predicate rather than "the PR looks merged". It now reads TRUE:

```
$ git grep -c "case 'field'" origin/main -- packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/bootstrap-declared-sharing-rules.ts
  1                                    ⇒ #15072's executor HAS landed
```

⇒ two of the card's sentences are now false, verbatim on `origin/main`:

```
sharing.zod.ts:91    "…until it lands, the declared-rule bootstrap skips a `field` rule with a logged warning"
sharing.zod.ts:262   "…its executor is the services half, #15072, and until that lands a `field` rule is skipped LOUDLY at seed"
```

⭐⭐ **But the card says THREE sentences, and this seat measures that the third is about something else entirely and may still be TRUE:**

```
sharing.zod.ts:110   "…runtime contract additionally reserves `queue` (no `sys_queue` yet) — it is
                      deliberately NOT authorable until the implementation lands."
```

That is about **`queue` / `sys_queue`**, ⛔ not about `field` / #15072. Whether it is false depends on whether `sys_queue` exists — a separate question this card never asked.

⇒ **Check `:110` on its own terms and report the reading.** If `sys_queue` still does not exist, that sentence is **still true** and ⛔ must be left alone; the PR then corrects two sentences, not three, and says why. ⛔ Do not edit a third line merely because the card's title counted three.

⚠️ Line numbers are from `origin/main` at the timestamp above. ⛔ Re-take them from the tree; every zero-hit grep needs a positive control on the same file or it is not a reading.
